diagram_previews.alt: Circle with centre O and a horizontal tangent line touching it at the bottom point B, with a point X on the tangent to the right. The chord BD runs up to D on the right of the circle; the arc BD between them is red and labelled arc BD. Dashed radii OB and OD, a right-angle mark at B between OB and the tangent, the central angle theta at O and the blue angle alpha at B between BX and BD.
